12Investigate nuisance alarms, repeat trouble conditions, device failures, communication issues, and other recurring problems; complete root-cause analysis and corrective action.

13Develop critical spare-parts plans and lifecycle replacement strategies for panels, power supplies, batteries, modules, detectors, notification devices, and communication equipment.

Position Summary:

The GU employee’s main tasks in closing are to inspect glass containers that are delivered to the closing area prior to closing. • Cut paper, cardboard, and other packaging materials as required to support packaging operations.

• Maintain housekeeping and 5S standards in assigned work areas.

title: Project Engineer
description:
About the Role:

The Project Engineer - Utility is responsible for planning, engineering, executing, and closing utility and infrastructure projects in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The position leads projects from problem definition and technical scope development through procurement, construction, commissioning, and final turnover. The role supports safe, reliable, code-compliant, and energy-efficient operation of the plant's utility systems while maintaining clear ownership of project cost, schedule, quality, risk, and documentation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Project definition and planning. Evaluate operational needs, recurring failures, capacity constraints, compliance gaps, and energy-saving opportunities; develop project charters, scopes of work, budgetary estimates, schedules, risk registers, and implementation plans.

• Engineering and technical design. Prepare or review calculations, equipment selections, layouts, one-line diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams, control narratives, technical specifications, bid packages, and construction drawings.

• Utility systems engineering. Support projects involving medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, compressed air, chilled and cooling water, process water and RO systems, wastewater and water-treatment systems, HVAC and dehumidification, natural gas, building controls, and related plant infrastructure.

• Capacity and reliability analysis. Analyze current and future utility demand, redundancy, equipment condition, failure history, and production impact; recommend technically and financially justified solutions.

• Cross-functional coordination. Coordinate requirements and project impacts with Production, Maintenance, Utility Operations, Facility, EHS, Quality, IT/Controls, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders. Communicate constraints, shutdown needs, risks, and decisions in a timely manner.

• Procurement and vendor management. Develop RFQ packages, conduct site walks, answer bidder questions, complete technical bid evaluations, support vendor selection, and verify that purchased equipment and services meet project requirements.

• Cost and change control. Track commitments, forecasts, invoices, contingency, and cost-to-complete; review contractor quotations and change orders; promptly escalate deviations from approved scope, budget, or schedule.

• Construction and contractor coordination. Coordinate field activities, access, permits, material staging, production interfaces, outages, and daily work plans. Inspect installation progress and workmanship and document deficiencies, action items, and recovery plans.

• Safety and compliance. Integrate applicable OSHA, NFPA, NEC, environmental, insurance, state, and local code requirements into project planning and execution. Coordinate LOTO, energized-work restrictions, hot work, lift plans, confined-space requirements, and other site safety controls with EHS and authorized personnel.

• Shutdown and cutover planning. Develop detailed method-of-procedure plans, outage schedules, temporary utility arrangements, contingency plans, and restoration steps to minimize production and business interruption.

• Quality assurance and commissioning. Verify submittals and installation quality; coordinate inspections, testing, FAT/SAT activities, startup, functional performance testing, punch-list closure, training, and formal acceptance.

• Project turnover and records. Deliver complete closeout packages, including approved drawings, as-built records, equipment data, O&M manuals, test reports, warranties, spare-parts recommendations, PM requirements, and asset information for the CMMS or equipment register.

• Operational and emergency support. Provide engineering troubleshooting and root-cause support for significant utility failures or project-related issues. Participate in planned shutdowns and occasional after-hours response when business needs require.

• Energy and continuous improvement. Identify and implement projects that reduce utility consumption, peak demand, operating cost, emissions, water use, and unplanned downtime; establish baselines and verify results using appropriate KPIs.

• Reporting and governance. Maintain accurate project schedules, meeting minutes, issue logs, risk registers, action lists, forecasts, status reports, and decision records. Follow applicable capital-approval and document-control processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

• Proven experience in project engineering or a similar role within the engineering or construction industry.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to produce and interpret detailed shop drawings.

• Strong understanding of project management principles and experience using Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling software.

• Demonstrated ability to perform cost estimation and manage change orders effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification.

• Experience with advanced engineering design software beyond AutoCAD.

• Familiarity with industry-specific codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Previous experience working on large-scale or complex engineering projects.

• Strong leadership skills with experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and review detailed engineering designs and shop drawings using AutoCAD to ensure accuracy and compliance with project specifications.

• Prepare and manage cost estimations, budgets, and change orders to maintain financial control throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate project activities by liaising with internal teams, contractors, and clients to ensure seamless communication and timely delivery of milestones.

• Utilize Microsoft Project to create, update, and monitor project schedules, identifying potential risks and implementing mitigation strategies.

• Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and presentations to communicate project status and engineering decisions to stakeholders.

Skills:

The required skills such as AutoCAD and shop drawing expertise are essential for creating precise engineering designs and ensuring technical accuracy on a daily basis. Project engineering and design skills enable the candidate to develop innovative solutions and adapt designs to meet evolving project needs. Cost estimation and change order management are critical for maintaining budgetary control and responding to project scope adjustments efficiently. Project coordination and the use of Microsoft Project facilitate effective scheduling, resource allocation, and communication among stakeholders, ensuring projects progress smoothly. Preferred skills like advanced design software proficiency and leadership capabilities further enhance the ability to manage complex projects and lead teams toward successful outcomes.

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. title: Process Engineer
description:
About the Role:

As a Process Engineer within the Automotive Glass Manufacturing Industry, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and enhancing manufacturing processes to ensure high-quality product delivery and operational efficiency. Your primary focus will be on analyzing current processes, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing innovative solutions that reduce waste and increase productivity. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply chain to align process improvements with business objectives. Utilizing advanced process simulation and control techniques, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives that support sustainable manufacturing practices. Ultimately, your expertise will contribute to delivering superior consumer products while maintaining cost-effectiveness and compliance with industry standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in process engineering within a manufacturing or consumer support environment.

• Strong knowledge of process simulation tools and methodologies.

• Proficiency in process control techniques and manufacturing operations.

• Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

• Certification in Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement methodologies.

• Experience working in consumer goods manufacturing or support services.

• Familiarity with advanced process automation and control systems.

• Demonstrated success in scrap reduction and waste management projects.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and product quality.

• Conduct process simulations and modeling to predict and enhance process performance.

• Implement process control strategies to maintain consistent production standards and reduce variability.

• Analyze production data using statistical tools such as Minitab to identify trends and root causes of scrap or defects.

• Collaborate with manufacturing operations teams to troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective actions.

• Lead initiatives aimed at scrap reduction and waste minimization to support sustainability goals.

• Document process changes and maintain detailed records to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards.

• Train and support production staff on new processes and best practices to ensure smooth implementation.

Skills:

The required skills such as Chemical Engineering and Process Engineering form the foundation for designing and optimizing manufacturing workflows. Process Simulation and Process Control skills are applied daily to model processes and maintain consistent production quality. Manufacturing Operations knowledge enables effective collaboration with production teams to implement improvements and troubleshoot issues. Scrap Reduction expertise is critical for identifying inefficiencies and driving cost-saving initiatives. Proficiency in Minitab supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing production data to uncover trends and root causes, ensuring continuous process enhancement.

title: In Process Quality Control
description:
About Fuyao
Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North American market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW, and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.

Our Parent Company
Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia, and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of the Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of the Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few.

Position: IPQC (In Process Quality Control)

Classification: Non-Exempt

Backup: IPQC LEAD/GP12

Related KPI:

• Customer Complaint

• Liaison Feedback Times

• Internal Batch Issues

Summary/Objective

Ensure that the parts being produced meet quality specifications. Help monitor part quality on the Production floor.

Essential Functions

• Perform the First Piece Approval Process with Team Leads and Technicians to ensure the parts conform to standards.

• Monitor the quality of the parts on the line and ensure that the parts meet standards by performing sample audits on the first and last pieces.

• Perform Daily Process Audits online to make sure that processes are being followed.

• Provide support in training GP12 in job duties and work instructions.

• Dock Audit is responsible for assigned programs.

• Help with containments and proper disposition of the non-conforming material found during Containment.

• Must be familiar with ISO/TS 16949

• Communication Proficiency.

• Ethical Conduct.

Support IPQE and IPQC LEAD to monitor GP12.

This is a full-time position. Days of work are Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

title: EHS Manager
description:
Summary/Objective:
Reporting to Fuyao Automotive North America, Inc., this position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations. The EHS Manager establishes goals and metrics, drives safety leadership, fosters a strong safety culture, and ensures environmental management best practices. As an integral member of the site leadership team, this role influences decision-making and promotes cross-functional collaboration to enhance workplace safety and compliance.

Essential Functions:

• Leads and/or assists in the implementation of comprehensive environmental, safety and health programs, policies, and procedures.

• Monitors regulatory arena for new/changing regulations and rulemaking; adjusts programs/procedures accordingly.

• Leads risk identification programs (including various inspection programs); act as a technical resource for the sharing of regulatory requirements and best practices.

• Leads safety related audit and inspection processes and open issues tracking.

• Serves as technical resource for incident investigation and causal factor/root cause analysis may lead investigations.

• Liaisons with and provides recommendations to Develops, implements, and oversees site-wide environmental, health, and safety policies and procedures.

• Monitors and ensures compliance with all applicable EHS regulations, including MIOSHA, EPA, NIOSH, and NFPA standards.

• Identifies and mitigates workplace hazards through risk assessments, audits, and inspections.

• Leads incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

• Establishes and tracks key safety performance metrics (leading and lagging indicators) to drive continuous improvement.

• Maintains required regulatory records and ensures timely submission of reports and notifications.

• Coordinates and communicates EHS policies and updates across all departments and levels of the organization.

description:
About Fuyao

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.

Our Parent Company

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few.

title: TOOLING ENGINEER
description:
About the Role:

As a Tooling Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining the tools and equipment necessary for efficient manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and cost-effectiveness by ensuring that tooling solutions meet stringent specifications and operational requirements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance to optimize tooling designs and resolve any issues that arise during production. This role requires a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement to support evolving product lines and manufacturing technologies. Ultimately, your expertise will help drive the successful delivery of high-quality products while minimizing downtime and tooling-related costs.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or CATIA for tooling design.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes including machining, stamping, injection molding, or casting.

• Experience with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and engineering drawings.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Engineering or related discipline.

• Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) software and ERP systems.

• Knowledge of automation and robotics integration in tooling design.

• Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing certification.

• Previous experience working in automotive, aerospace, or heavy machinery industries.

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop tooling solutions including jigs, fixtures, dies, molds, and gauges to support manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with product design and manufacturing teams to ensure tooling designs meet functional and quality requirements.

• Conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to optimize tooling designs for manufacturability and efficiency.

• Oversee the fabrication, testing, and validation of tooling to ensure compliance with specifications and performance standards.

• Troubleshoot and resolve tooling issues during production to minimize downtime and maintain product quality.

• Maintain detailed documentation of tooling designs, modifications, and maintenance activities.

• Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance tooling performance and reduce manufacturing costs.

• Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for tooling procurement and maintenance services.

Skills:

The required skills such as CAD proficiency and knowledge of manufacturing processes are essential for creating precise and functional tooling designs that meet production needs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills enable the engineer to troubleshoot tooling issues quickly and implement effective solutions to minimize production delays. Communication and collaboration skills are vital for working with cross-functional teams and suppliers to ensure tooling aligns with product and process requirements. Preferred skills like experience with PLM software and Lean methodologies support continuous improvement efforts and efficient management of tooling assets. Additionally, familiarity with automation technologies allows the engineer to design tooling that integrates seamlessly with modern manufacturing systems, enhancing overall productivity.

Languages:

English,proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.

About the Role:

As a Tooling Engineer based in the United States, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining the tools and equipment essential for manufacturing processes. Your expertise will ensure that tooling solutions are efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with production goals, directly impacting product quality and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance to optimize tooling designs and troubleshoot issues. This role demands a proactive approach to continuous improvement, leveraging engineering principles to innovate and enhance tooling systems. Ultimately, your contributions will support the seamless production of high-quality products while minimizing downtime and manufacturing costs.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• Proven experience in tooling design and development within a manufacturing environment.

• Strong knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for tooling design.

• Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as machining, stamping, molding, or assembly.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with CNC programming and operation.

• Knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) standards.

• Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing certification.

• Experience working in automotive, aerospace, or heavy machinery industries.

• Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and validate tooling and fixtures to support manufacturing processes.

• Collaborate with product design and manufacturing teams to ensure tooling meets production requirements and quality standards.

• Analyze existing tooling performance and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.

• Troubleshoot and resolve tooling-related issues during production to minimize downtime.

• Manage tooling documentation, including specifications, drawings, and maintenance records.

• Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for tooling procurement and maintenance services.

• Support the implementation of new manufacturing technologies and processes related to tooling.

Skills:

The required skills such as CAD proficiency and manufacturing process knowledge are essential for designing precise and functional tooling that meets production needs. Problem-solving abilities enable the engineer to quickly identify and resolve tooling issues, ensuring minimal disruption to manufacturing. Collaboration skills are vital as the role involves working closely with multiple departments to align tooling solutions with product and process requirements. Preferred skills like CNC programming and knowledge of GD&T enhance the engineer’s capability to create more sophisticated tooling and ensure dimensional accuracy. Additionally, certifications in Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing support continuous improvement initiatives, driving efficiency and quality in tooling operations.

3rd Shift (11:00pm - 7:00am)
Must be 18 years of age or older.

Job Summary: Leader of Program Management Team (Iron Triangle). Program Manager works with the Product Development Engineer and Advance Quality Engineer to quote, develop and launch new automotive glass products for OEMs. The PM will communicate directly with the customer on all matters concerning the initial launch of Windshields, Backlights, Doors, Quarter windows, and Sunroofs. Represent Fuyao at customer development events and meetings. Maintain documents in
accordance with Fuyao policies, APQP and Customer deliverables.

• New Product Launch - Automotive Glass -Capable of handling OEM Customers and multiple programs/window openings.

• Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills

• Languages spoken in the workplace are English and Mandarin

• Previous positions of demonstrated dynamic matrix management, budget controls and timing chart creation

• Bachelor of Science in Engineering fields or Business Management

• Masters degree is preferred

• Safety FIRST! Mindset is required

• Ability to walk or move around the plant for extended periods of time. Some lifting up to 35 lbs. with assistance is expected

• MS Office, Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Preferred MS Project skilled

• Outlook is the email client. Also use of Skype, and SharePoint navigation

• Knowledge of and familiarity MRP/ERP software. PLEX is current shop standard

• Skilled in documentation of APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning ) & PPAP ( Production Part Approval Process)

• Manufacturing processes-Hi speed assembly, packaging, preferred glass bending and manufacturing

• Presentation - Oral and Written, Power Point or similar

• Leadership ability (w/ motivational & cooperative aptitude)

• Demonstrated decision making/leadership abilities in managing multiple programs to meet goals (quality, cost and delivery of programs) from concept through launch

• TS16949 training

• Training about innovation methods

About Fuyao

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.

Our Parent Company

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. description:
About Fuyao

Fuyao Automotive North America Incorporated (FANA) is in the general warehousing and glass manufacturing industry in Plymouth MI. We provide automotive glass for the North America market and currently have glass manufacturing relationships with some of the top automotive manufacturers in North America including GM, Honda, Chrysler, Kia, BMW and Hyundai. We operate several production lines for a variety of vehicle models from each of these automotive manufacturers.

Our Parent Company

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co. Ltd. (FYG) is a leading international manufacturer of automotive and industrial glass located in the People's Republic of China. The company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1993 and employs more than 8,000 people in China, Hong Kong, Europe, Australia, Russia and the United States. Being the largest automotive glass supplier in China, FYG controls over 60% share of Chinese OEM market and over 30% share of Chinese replacement market. Fuyao customers in China are some of the leading automotive manufacturers in the world including GM, Ford, Honda, Toyota, Audi, Volkswagen, Citroen, and Mercedes-Benz to name a few.

The Float Glass Keeper plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, safety, and efficient handling of float glass products within the consumer support services industry. This position is responsible for overseeing the storage, inventory management, and protection of float glass materials to prevent damage and maintain product integrity. The role requires close collaboration with production, logistics, and quality assurance teams to coordinate the timely movement and proper care of glass products. The Float Glass Keeper ensures compliance with safety standards and operational procedures to minimize risks associated with handling fragile materials. Ultimately, this position contributes to customer satisfaction by maintaining high-quality standards and supporting seamless supply chain operations.

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Experience in warehouse or inventory management, preferably in handling fragile or glass products.

• Basic knowledge of safety standards related to material handling.

• Ability to operate material handling equipment such as forklifts or pallet jacks.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Certification in forklift operation or other relevant equipment.

• Experience working in the consumer support services or glass manufacturing industry.

• Familiarity with inventory management software and systems.

• Training in occupational health and safety standards.

• Strong communication skills to effectively coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities:

• Manage the receipt, storage, and dispatch of float glass products, ensuring accurate inventory records are maintained.

• Inspect glass materials regularly for any signs of damage or defects and report issues promptly to the quality control team.

• Coordinate with production and logistics teams to schedule and facilitate the safe movement of glass products within the facility.

• Implement and adhere to safety protocols to prevent accidents and ensure a safe working environment for all personnel.
